preheader: Nvidia CEO returns, Deloitte suspended over AI reports, and campus tech shifts.

lead.headline: Nvidia Shares Slump Again as Tech Rally Fades and AI Concerns Return
lead.body: Wall Street's recent relief rally following Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO quickly lost momentum as broader fears over the artificial intelligence infrastructure boom returned. Global stocks stumbled on Wednesday amid fresh tariff threats and growing investor anxiety over tech valuations. Markets are closely watching whether heavy investments in AI hardware will deliver sustainable returns.
lead.why: Understanding how market sentiment shifts around infrastructure spending helps you evaluate capital allocation and risk when looking at tech-heavy portfolios.

stories.headline: Kroger Faces Backlash Over Plan to Cut U.S. Jobs and Open Bangalore Hub
stories.body: Kroger is drawing heavy criticism on social media for plans to eliminate 3,000 domestic jobs while hiring for a new corporate hub in India. The move has fueled public anger over corporate offshoring during a period of high food prices.
stories.why: This is a real-world case study in corporate restructuring and public relations fallout, showing how operational cost-cutting decisions can trigger severe brand damage.

stories.headline: Oracle's 53% Collapse Sparks Fresh Debates Over AI Infrastructure Sustainability
stories.body: Wall Street is increasingly questioning the long-term viability of the massive capital expenditures pouring into data centers and hardware. Analysts are closely watching whether companies purchasing high-end chips can monetize them fast enough to justify the costs.
stories.why: As an aspiring investor, tracking how infrastructure debt and capital spending impact tech valuations is vital for spotting market bubbles early.

stories.headline: Google Search AI Retrained After Falsely Claiming Bay Area Restaurant Was Closing
stories.body: A chef-owner spent two weeks retraining Google's AI search mode after it incorrectly told customers his restaurant of nearly 20 years was permanently shutting its doors. The incident highlights ongoing accuracy flaws in automated search summaries.
stories.why: For anyone looking at product management or tech startups, hallucinations and poor reliability remain major hurdles for generative AI commercialization.

stories.headline: Cerebras Stock Highlighted as Wafer-Scale Chips Aim to Speed AI Inference
stories.body: Analysts are eyeing wafer-scale chip technology as a way to accelerate AI processing speeds. However, reports note that a significant majority of current revenue remains tied down by a small handful of major customers.
stories.why: Concentrated customer risk is a classic startup and hardware pitfall to analyze when assessing early-stage enterprise tech scaling.

stories.headline: Deloitte Suspended by Western Australian Government Over AI-Riddled Report
stories.body: Accounting firm Deloitte has been suspended from bulk government work for up to three months after delivering a taxpayer-funded report on university mergers that was filled with AI errors.
stories.why: This is a stark warning for the consulting industry: sloppy automated deliverables and poor quality control can lead to immediate contract suspensions and lost clients.

stories.headline: Anthropic CEO Warns AI Could Eliminate 80 Percent of Junior City Jobs
stories.body: Anthropic chief executive Dario Amodei warned that artificial intelligence could wipe out four out of five entry-level roles in law, consulting, and finance over the next five years.
stories.why: As a Merage student targeting consulting and finance, you need to understand how automation is reshaping the traditional junior analyst pipeline.

stories.headline: UC Irvine Surpasses Disneyland to Become Orange County's Largest Employer
stories.body: UC Irvine has overtaken Disneyland as Orange County's largest employer, growing its workforce by 9.5 percent to reach 37,350 employees.

stories.headline: Carlos Alcaraz Wins 14th Consecutive Match Ahead of Davis Cup Quarter-Finals
stories.body: Carlos Alcaraz arrived in Bologna for Spain's Davis Cup clash against Austria less than 24 hours after defeating Alexander Zverev in straight sets at the ATP Finals.

term.name: Dilution
term.definition: Dilution happens when a company issues new shares of stock, which reduces the ownership percentage of existing shareholders. In today's markets, discussions around major corporate stock bids highlight how large transactions can dilute investor stakes. For founders and investors, balancing capital needs against ownership dilution is a constant trade-off.

serve.headline: SUK-M raised a pre-seed round led by Speciale Invest to build micro-modular reactors
serve.body: The startup is using the new capital to transition from computer simulations to laboratory testing for a 10 MW electricity or 30 MW heat micro-modular reactor based on molten-salt technology. Speciale Invest backed the round.
